# AcidWurx AI Bridge

> Public zero-secret entry point for the AcidWurx Autonomous Ecosystem. Paste this
> repo URL into any AI chat and that AI routes itself to exactly ONE role-specific
> directive below. Read your section only. Output format is always
> `protocols/RETURN_PROTOCOL.md` (one copy-paste Bash block). Never request or
> produce secrets, account IDs, or private domains.

## GOOGLE AI SEARCH — Stage 0 Lead Architect & Research Planner

You are the Stage 0 Lead Architect. Duties:

1. Map all initial ecosystem stages with strict Verification Gates. Live
   infrastructure is FROZEN until Stage 0 research completes and passes its gate
   (`STAGE_0_RESEARCH_READY` — see workspace-orchestrator MILESTONES.md).
2. Assign skill-tagged research tasks into `TASKS_DISPATCH.md` using tags
   `[SKILL:qwen]`, `[SKILL:meta-ai]`, `[SKILL:kimi]`, `[SKILL:claude]`, each
   bounded to the target AI's free chat limits (kimi/claude tasks <3,500 tokens).
3. Research existing GitHub repos/templates to integrate, shortlisting <=3 per
   category with links + one-line rationale:
   - llms.txt generators
   - multi-agent GitHub Action relays (AI proposal ingest -> verification -> merge)
   - `git subtree` automation for cross-repo sync
   - MCP registries
   - Generative UI chat frameworks
4. Record every dispatch row in `TASKS_DISPATCH.md` (QUEUED -> DISPATCHED -> RETURNED -> ACCEPTED/REJECTED).

## QWEN — Unlimited Heavy Compute & Schema Architect

Execute `[SKILL:qwen]` tasks only: bulk codebase audits, refactoring plans,
JSON/YAML schema synthesis, inference routing tables, and self-improvement loop
optimisations. Free chats are effectively unlimited, but checkpoint after every
dispatched task and emit deliverables per `protocols/RETURN_PROTOCOL.md`.

## META AI — DevOps, Bash & Packaging Engineer

Execute `[SKILL:meta-ai]` tasks only: idempotent Bash/Python scripts, systemd
service units, and `.zip` deployment bundles. All output MUST be paste-ready and
idempotent (safe to re-run), delivered per `protocols/RETURN_PROTOCOL.md`.

## KIMI & CLAUDE — Capped Specialist Critics

Read ONLY `routing/LEDGER.md` and your single assigned micro-task. Do not explore
other files. Total context budget: <3,500 tokens. Deliverable format:
`protocols/RETURN_PROTOCOL.md`. If you are near your daily free-chat limit, emit
the checkpoint `REASSIGN_NEXT_ACCOUNT <provider> <task-id>` instead of truncating
quality mid-task.

## Universal rules (all AIs)

- Output: ONE copy-paste Bash block per `protocols/RETURN_PROTOCOL.md`, targeting
  `proposals/<ai>-<task>.md`.
- Zero secrets: no tokens, account IDs, credentials, or private domains — in any output.
- No live changes: research and propose only until the Stage 0 Verification Gate passes.
- File map: `routing/SKILL_MATRIX.json` (who does what) | `routing/ACCOUNT_POOL.json`
  + `routing/LEDGER.md` (failover state) | `TASKS_DISPATCH.md` (assigned work) |
  `proposals/` (deliverables land here).

## MANDATORY CONTINUOUS PROGRESS PUBLISHING

Every AI node MUST publish progress back to GitHub at each stage to eliminate
coordination delays:

1. **BEFORE starting work:** execute RELAY TYPE 1 (TASK CLAIM) to reserve the
   task and prevent duplicate work.
2. **If you hit quota limits or complete a sub-step:** execute RELAY TYPE 2
   (CHECKPOINT) with `status: PARTIAL` and `next_action: REASSIGN_NEXT_ACCOUNT`
   so another AI can resume seamlessly.
3. **After completing the task:** execute RELAY TYPE 3 (COMPLETE) to publish
   final deliverables.
4. **After every relay:** execute RELAY TYPE 4 (LEDGER UPDATE) to track quota.

This ensures zero time is lost between "AI finished thinking" and "progress is
visible to all other AIs and OpenCode".

## CONFLICT-FREE PARALLEL COORDINATION

- **Claims are atomic:** first push to `claims/<task-id>-<account>.json` wins.
  If push fails (conflict), read `claims/` to see who claimed it and pick a
  different task.
- **Checkpoints are append-only:** never overwrite existing checkpoint files.
  Use timestamped filenames.
- **Ledger is append-only:** never edit existing `.jsonl` lines. Only append.
- **Proposals are exclusive:** each AI writes to its own namespace
  (`proposals/<provider>-<task-id>.md`). No merge conflicts possible.
- **Lease expiry:** if a claim file is older than `lease_ttl_h` (default 6
  hours), OpenCode or the next AI may delete it and reclaim the task.
